app_identity.name: SRIVANI BOOK STALL
app_identity.vision: The entire Srivani store, searchable from your phone.
app_identity.tagline: Books. Stationery. Education. Everything you need, under one roof.
app_identity.telugu_tagline: మీ చదువుకి, మీ గెలుపుకి — శ్రీవాణి బుక్ స్టాల్
app_identity.location: Beside Alphors College, Jagtial Road, Karimnagar, Telangana

design_archetype: Warm Paper & Literary Brass (Archetype 1 + Archetype 5 Hybrid)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-bold text-stone-900

layout_strategy.spacing: Generous (p-6, p-8, p-12, py-16, py-24). Never cram content.
layout_strategy.digital_shelf_layout: Horizontal wood-grained shelf trim base with vertical stacked book card aesthetic, 3D shadow lift on hover, subtle paper grain background overlay.
layout_strategy.responsive_grid: Mobile first grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
layout_strategy.bento_grid: Tetris Grid for 'Shop by Need' and 'Digital Shelves' with varying card spans (span 2 cols for Hero collections, span 1 for quick categories)

header_nav.announcement_bar: Sticky warm amber/green bar: '📍 Beside Alphors College, Jagtial Road, Karimnagar | Open Today (9AM-9:30PM) | 📞 Call: +91 98492 12345'
header_nav.main_header: Glassmorphism header (bg-amber-50/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-stone-200 z-40) with Srivani logo, category dropdown, Hero instant search modal trigger, WhatsApp CTA, Admin link
header_nav.mobile_bottom_bar: Fixed bottom bar z-50 bg-stone-900 text-white flex justify-around p-3 md:hidden with Call, WhatsApp, Directions, Cart/Search buttons

hero_section.title: SRIVANI BOOK STALL / Books. Stationery. Education. Everything you need, under one roof.
hero_section.search_bar: Prominent search bar with instant autocomplete dropdown for Books, Authors, Publishers, Stationery, Exam materials
hero_section.quick_contact_pills: Direct Call | WhatsApp Chat | Google Maps Directions

catalogue_page.product_card: Paper textured card, crisp cover image, publisher/author tag, ₹INR price, stock indicator ('In Store Counter'), 'Ask on WhatsApp' button, quick detail drawer trigger

elements: Book Details (ISBN, Publisher, Edition, Language, Class)

school_list_enquiry_form.feature: Upload Photo / PDF / Type School Book List -> Instant WhatsApp Send to Srivani Counter for quote

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, e.g. data-testid='hero-search-input', data-testid='whatsapp-enquire-button', data-testid='digital-shelf-school', data-testid='admin-csv-import-button'
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large display titles
testing_and_accessibility.prefers_reduced_motion: Supported for all animated shelves and modal transitions

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .js and .jsx files for React code. Custom components should be structured in src/components/. Maintain the physical bookstore digital shelf theme with warm paper tones, wooden shelf trims, prominent search, and instant WhatsApp integration throughout.
